summary: Agroz Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of a Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, approved by special resolution on May 22, 2026. The amendment increases authorized share capital from US$11,500 to US$102,000, re-designates existing ordinary shares as Class A ordinary shares, creates 900,000,000 new Class A ordinary shares and 5,000,000 Class B ordinary shares with 100 votes per share. The filing is a routine capital reorganization, not a special situation event.
